mechanism_narrative: Sustained high housing starts (HOUST > 850) indicate robust construction activity and consumer confidence, directly supporting corporate revenue growth and positive equity market returns over the next 5 trading days as economic momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST exceeds 850.0 (thousands of units) over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% signals aggressive monetary easing that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% and CPIAUCSL below 230 indicates low-rate, low-inflation conditions that reduce real interest rate risk and support equity market expansion over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.1 AND CPIAUCSL < 230.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 6.0% reflect economic weakness and reduced consumer spending power, typically causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as corporate earnings face downward pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0% over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated industrial production (INDPRO > 105) signals strong manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency, directly supporting corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when INDPRO exceeds 105.0 is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL below 230 indicates stable low inflation that reduces economic uncertainty and supports sustained equity market gains over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when CPIAUCSL < 230 is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales below 400,000 (RSAFS < 400000) indicate weakening consumer demand for housing, typically triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as economic growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS < 400000 over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST > 850) and residential sales (RSAFS > 400000) indicate broad-based consumer demand strength across multiple sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 850 and RSAFS > 400000.
